difficulty_reason: The lemma records that twisting a quasi-coherent module by the sign sheaf attached to a character leaves it quasi-coherent (statement lines 1304-1310). The proof notes that the module structure is clear, that quasi-coherence can be checked etale locally, and that the twisting factor is finite locally free, so that tensoring preserves the property. The locality reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
